name: Wind-borne mandibles
description: The thrown mandibles with the air they ride: `ss.proj.boom` composed via `use`, and two arcs trailing off the outer corner. Each arc is drawn twice — a wide ink stroke, then the spore-bright one on top — because a hairline arc over the plate's glow loses its edge at the size this is seen at. The mandibles are the document the field throws, not a second drawing of it.

glyph.description: Plate off, object only — the silhouette a collection shows for an entry not yet met.
